one_v_one.name: Learner
one_v_one.doc: Orbits and dodges; aims with a guess-factor gun that learns across battles.

one_v_one.name: SquadLeader
one_v_one.doc: Squad leader: spins its radar and reports every enemy to the team.

one_v_one.name: FirstTank
one_v_one.doc: Sweeps its gun until the radar sees someone, then aims and fires.

one_v_one.name: SpinBot
one_v_one.doc: Circles and spins its gun; fires at anything the radar sweeps.

one_v_one.name: Tracker
one_v_one.doc: Radar lock, head-on aim, keeps ~10 cells distance.

one_v_one.name: Corners
one_v_one.doc: Camps in its best corner (learned across battles) and sweeps its gun.

one_v_one.name: RamFire
one_v_one.doc: Charges the nearest enemy and rams it; weak shots point-blank.

one_v_one.name: Walls
one_v_one.doc: Drives along the arena edges, gun pointing inwards; shoots what it sees.

survival.name: LevyForager
survival.doc: Grazes food in sight; otherwise searches with Lévy-flight runs.

survival.name: Grazer
survival.doc: Stays on food until it's eaten; goes for the richest food in sight.

survival.name: WandererAgent
survival.doc: Walk to the nearest visible food; otherwise wander randomly.

survival.name: Sharer
survival.doc: Grazes; shares rich food finds with creatures it can see; follows tips.
